description: Find known vulnerabilities in package versions and website technologies, ranked by what to fix first. Send a version list, lockfile, CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM, or Wappalyzer export. For a WordPress inventory of core, plugins and themes, use check_wordpress.

file.description: A whole file: a lockfile (recognized by its name), a CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM, or a Wappalyzer JSON or CSV export. Up to 5 MB.

name.description: The file name, such as package-lock.json, bom.json or wappalyzer.csv.

ecosystem.description: npm, PyPI, Maven, Go, crates.io, RubyGems, Packagist, NuGet, Hex or Pub.

version.description: One exact version, not a range.

technologies.description: Website technologies, as Wappalyzer or a person names them.

name.description: Such as nginx, PHP, WordPress or jQuery.

name: check_stack

fix_first.description: Up to 10 findings, most urgent first.

title: Check dependencies, SBOMs and website technologies
